messages:
harper_infra: postmortem follow-up for the on-prem isolation incident that affected PAYWELL. root cause: VPC peering route drift during BGP flap + aggressive isolation enforcement on agent startup. listing remediation actions below, pls claim.

anya_prod: can we prioritize customer communication? they want a clear ETA for rollback vs hotfix.

leo_sre: i'll take remediation work. short plan: 1) implement explicit route reconciliation when peering reports UP, 2) add a 30s startup grace window before applying STRICT isolation, and 3) add a periodic route-refresh cron on agents. hotfix ETA: 36-48h. will open PRs and attach to INC-2026-470.

maria_support: i'll draft the customer note after we have hotfix ETA; will include rollback option.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-470 | severity: high | owner: leo_sre | status: investigating

leo_sre: quick note: the agent state machine currently does not verify route convergence before switching to STRICT. mitigation (short-term): delay STRICT by default and expose `isolation_enforce_delay` for operators. will scan installs for non-default values.

harper_infra: i'll update the dedicated deploy pipeline to include the hotfix as a must-gate for Private tenants.

anya_prod: i'll run a sweep of private installs for `isolation_enforce_delay` overrides and flag any that set it to 0. report back in 12h.

leo_sre: scan result: PAYWELL and ARCADIA had 0s overrides. flagging PAYWELL as impacted; ARCADIA marked medium risk.

maria_support: scheduling customer call with PAYWELL infra for tomorrow AM. will offer canary rollback to v2.2.9 if they prefer immediate mitigation.

harper_infra: action list (confirm owners):
- leo_sre: implement route reconcile + startup grace + agent cron refresh (ETA: 36-48h)
- harper_infra: add hotfix as must-gate in dedicated deploy pipeline (ETA: today)
- anya_prod: inventory of non-default enforcement configs (ETA: 12h)
- maria_support: customer comms & canary rollback scheduling (ETA: before end of day)

leo_sre: also noting pattern: this is second peering-related isolation issue in 4 months. propose recurring incident ticket and an RFC to add proactive peering health checks to runtime. will draft RFC this week.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-470 updated | owner: leo_sre | status: in-progress

harper_infra: thanks team. please paste PRs, runbooks, and the customer note into the INC ticket. i'll run a quick follow-up in tomorrow's triage to confirm rollout plan.
